text: Silvia...! Silvia, do you copy me? The signal... it punched through the electrostatic gale!
Two thousand and ninety light-years... the celestial hexagon... anchored between Achernar and Polaris! By the stars, you have done it!
The storm is tearing the world apart out here! The winds are shifting entire mountains of stone and sand!
All previous maps of the desert are dead paper now. The crescent dunes have slid miles south, ancient ravines are buried, and the raiders are as lost and stranded as we are in this shifting sea.
We lost their trail, but we hold the three stellar constants! In the deep desert, beyond the moved dunes, dwells the only ancient soul who can read the shifted sands: The Desert Oracle.
When this tempest subsides, we will navigate by your three chords directly to the Oracle's sanctuary!
Record every number in your Ledger, Silvia. Rest now while the winds blow. The Desert Path awaits us. Stay safe. Out.
